Make it like this:


<!DOCTYPE html>

<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<meta name="description" content="Interactive denim fabric hero banner — the cloth folds and casts a real shadow where your cursor presses into it.">
<title>Fabric Hero — Denim Cloth Demo</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Caveat:wght@600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    height: 100%;
    background: #0b1220;
  }

.hero {position: relative;width: 100%;height: 100vh;overflow: hidden;background: radial-gradient(120% 100% at 50% 0%, #23375f 0%, #172845 45%, #0c1830 100%);display: flex;align-items: center;justify-content: center;}

.hero canvas {position: absolute;inset: 0;width: 100%;height: 100%;}

.hero-content {position: relative;z-index: 2;text-align: center;color: #eef2ff;font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;pointer-events: none;padding: 0 20px;width: 100%;max-width: 900px;}

/* ---- Handwritten headline ---- */.stitch-text {position: relative;display: flex;justify-content: center;align-items: center;min-height: 1.4em;margin: 0 0 14px;font-weight: 400;}

.stitch-phrase {position: relative;display: inline-block;font-family: 'Caveat', 'Segoe Script', 'Brush Script MT', cursive;font-weight: 700;font-size: clamp(38px, 7.5vw, 78px);line-height: 1.2;color: #f3f6ff;filter: drop-shadow(0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.35));}

.stitch-phrase.is-writing {clip-path: inset(0 100% 0 0);animation-name: writeIn;animation-timing-function: cubic-bezier(.34,0,.2,1);animation-fill-mode: forwards;}

@keyframes writeIn {to { clip-path: inset(0 0% 0 0); }}

.stitch-phrase.fade-out {animation: fadeOutPen 0.6s ease forwards;}

@keyframes fadeOutPen {to { opacity: 0; filter: blur(6px) drop-shadow(0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0)); }}

.pen-tip {position: absolute;top: 8%;left: 0;width: 3px;height: 84%;border-radius: 2px;background: #ffe9a8;box-shadow: 0 0 10px 3px rgba(255, 226, 150, 0.85), 0 0 22px 8px rgba(255, 200, 90, 0.35);opacity: 0;pointer-events: none;will-change: transform, opacity;}

.hero-content p {font-size: clamp(14px, 2vw, 18px);color: rgba(238,242,255,0.75);margin: 0;}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {.hero canvas { display: none; }.stitch-phrase.is-writing { animation: none !important; clip-path: none !important; opacity: 1 !important; filter: none !important; }.pen-tip { display: none; }}</style>

</head>
<body>

<section class="hero" id="fabricHero" aria-label="Welcome banner with animated fabric background">
  <canvas id="fabricCanvas" aria-hidden="true"></canvas>
  <div class="hero-content">
    <h1 class="stitch-text" id="stitchText"><span class="stitch-phrase is-static">Hello World</span></h1>
    <p>The fabric ripples where your cursor moves — no click needed.</p>
  </div>
</section>

<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  var section = document.getElementById('fabricHero');
  var canvas = document.getElementById('fabricCanvas');
  var stitchEl = document.getElementById('stitchText');

  var prefersReducedMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------
  // Handwritten headline (unchanged)
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------
  var PHRASES = ['Hello World', 'Hello my friend', 'Hello my sister'];
  var MS_PER_CHAR = 95;
  var MIN_WRITE_MS = 700;
  var HOLD_MS = 1500;
  var FADE_MS = 650;
  var phraseIndex = 0;
  var stitchTimer = null;
  var firstRun = true;

  function attachPenTip(span, writeMs) {
    var tip = document.createElement('span');
    tip.className = 'pen-tip';
    span.appendChild(tip);
    var width = span.getBoundingClientRect().width;
    if (!width || !tip.animate) return;
    tip.animate(
      [
        { transform: 'translateX(0px)', opacity: 1 },
        { transform: 'translateX(0px)', opacity: 1, offset: 0.02 },
        { transform: 'translateX(' + width + 'px)', opacity: 1, offset: 0.94 },
        { transform: 'translateX(' + width + 'px)', opacity: 0 }
      ],
      { duration: writeMs, easing: 'cubic-bezier(.34,0,.2,1)', fill: 'forwards' }
    );
  }

  function runStitchCycle() {
    var text = PHRASES[phraseIndex];
    var writeMs = Math.max(MIN_WRITE_MS, text.length * MS_PER_CHAR);

    var span;
    if (firstRun && stitchEl.querySelector('.is-static')) {
      span = stitchEl.querySelector('.is-static');
      span.classList.remove('is-static');
    } else {
      stitchEl.innerHTML = '';
      span = document.createElement('span');
      span.className = 'stitch-phrase';
      span.textContent = text;
      stitchEl.appendChild(span);
    }
    firstRun = false;

    if (prefersReducedMotion) {
      stitchTimer = setTimeout(function () {
        phraseIndex = (phraseIndex + 1) % PHRASES.length;
        runStitchCycle();
      }, HOLD_MS + 900);
      return;
    }

    span.classList.add('is-writing');
    span.style.animationDuration = writeMs + 'ms';
    attachPenTip(span, writeMs);

    stitchTimer = setTimeout(function () {
      span.classList.add('fade-out');
      stitchTimer = setTimeout(function () {
        phraseIndex = (phraseIndex + 1) % PHRASES.length;
        runStitchCycle();
      }, FADE_MS);
    }, writeMs + HOLD_MS);
  }

  runStitchCycle();

  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function () {
    if (document.hidden) clearTimeout(stitchTimer);
  });

  if (prefersReducedMotion) return;

  var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d', { alpha: true });

  // ---- Tunable settings ----
  var COLS = 36;
  var MAX_ROWS = 54;
  var EXTRA_SAG_ROWS = 5;
  var OVERSCAN = 1.08;
  var GRAVITY = 2100;
  var HOVER_RADIUS = 92;
  var HOVER_STRENGTH = 0.12;
  var MAX_HOVER_DELTA = 24;
  var SINK_STRENGTH = 2500;
  var WIND_STRENGTH = 40;
  var EDGE_WIND_BOOST = 2.2;
  var PHYSICS_PASSES = 2;
  var DAMPING = 0.985;
  var SETTLE_STEPS = 180;
  var QUAD_OVERLAP = 1.035;

  // ---- Lighting / material ----
  var LIGHT_X = -0.55, LIGHT_Y = -0.82;
  var BASE_FALLBACK_COLOR = '#33517c'; // shown for the few frames before the
                                        // real denim photo has decoded

  // Real photographed denim, embedded inline (no extra network request —
  // this is the exact texture the client supplied) and tiled with a
  // mirrored 2x2 wrap so the repeat has no visible hard seam.
  var DENIM_SRC = "data:image/jpeg;base64,";

  var width = 0, height = 0, spacing = 0;
  var points = [];
  var constraints = [];
  var mouse = { x: -9999, y: -9999, px: -9999, py: -9999, active: false };
  var running = false;
  var rafId = null;
  var elapsed = 0;
  var denimPattern = null;

  // A tiny canvas, one pixel per mesh VERTEX (not per cell). We write each
  // point's lighting value into it as a single grayscale pixel, then draw
  // it stretched across the whole hero with the browser's own bilinear
  // image smoothing doing the blending between vertices. That smoothing is
  // what removes the hard-edged "cube" look — it's a continuous gradient
  // the same way a low-res height map looks smooth once scaled up, and
  // it's just one tiny pixel buffer write + one drawImage per frame,
  // regardless of how fine the mesh is.
  var lightMap = document.createElement('canvas');
  var lightMapCtx = lightMap.getContext('2d', { alpha: true });
  var lightMapData = null;
  var LIGHTMAP_SCALE = 0.55; // elevation units -> grayscale contrast

  function Point(x, y) {
    this.x = x; this.y = y;
    this.px = x; this.py = y;
    this.restX = x; this.restY = y;
    this.pinned = false;
    this.elev = 0;
  }

  var ROWS = 26;

  // Build a mirrored 2x2 wrap of the photo so createPattern('repeat') tiles
  // seamlessly (denim weave has no natural repeat, so a plain tile would
  // show a visible grid line — mirroring cancels that out). Done once,
  // off the main render loop, so it costs nothing per frame.
  function buildDenimPattern(img) {
    var tw = img.naturalWidth, th = img.naturalHeight;
    var tile = document.createElement('canvas');
    tile.width = tw * 2;
    tile.height = th * 2;
    var tctx = tile.getContext('2d');

    tctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, tw, th);

    tctx.save();
    tctx.translate(tw * 2, 0);
    tctx.scale(-1, 1);
    tctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, tw, th);
    tctx.restore();

    tctx.save();
    tctx.translate(0, th * 2);
    tctx.scale(1, -1);
    tctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, tw, th);
    tctx.restore();

    tctx.save();
    tctx.translate(tw * 2, th * 2);
    tctx.scale(-1, -1);
    tctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, tw, th);
    tctx.restore();

    denimPattern = ctx.createPattern(tile, 'repeat');
    draw();
  }

  (function loadDenim() {
    var img = new Image();
    img.onload = function () { buildDenimPattern(img); };
    img.src = DENIM_SRC;
  })();

  function buildCloth() {
    points = [];
    constraints = [];

    var rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    width = rect.width;
    height = rect.height;

    var dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    canvas.width = width * dpr;
    canvas.height = height * dpr;
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);

    var clothWidth = width * OVERSCAN;
    var startX = -(clothWidth - width) / 2;
    spacing = clothWidth / COLS;
    ROWS = Math.min(Math.ceil(height / spacing) + EXTRA_SAG_ROWS, MAX_ROWS);

    for (var y = 0; y <= ROWS; y++) {
      for (var x = 0; x <= COLS; x++) {
        var p = new Point(startX + x * spacing, y * spacing);
        if (y === 0) p.pinned = true;
        points.push(p);
      }
    }

    function idx(x, y) { return x + y * (COLS + 1); }
    for (var y2 = 0; y2 <= ROWS; y2++) {
      for (var x2 = 0; x2 <= COLS; x2++) {
        if (x2 < COLS) constraints.push([idx(x2, y2), idx(x2 + 1, y2)]);
        if (y2 < ROWS) constraints.push([idx(x2, y2), idx(x2, y2 + 1)]);
      }
    }

    lightMap.width = COLS + 1;
    lightMap.height = ROWS + 1;
    lightMapData = lightMapCtx.createImageData(COLS + 1, ROWS + 1);

    for (var s = 0; s < SETTLE_STEPS; s++) step(0.016);
    draw();
  }

  function step(dt) {
    elapsed += dt;

    for (var i = 0; i < points.length; i++) {
      var p = points[i];

      if (!p.pinned) {
        var ax = 0, ay = GRAVITY;

        var edgeT = Math.abs((p.x - width / 2) / (width / 2));
        var edgeBoost = 1 + edgeT * (EDGE_WIND_BOOST - 1);
        ax += Math.sin(elapsed * 0.7 + p.x * 0.045 + p.y * 0.01) * WIND_STRENGTH * edgeBoost;
        ay += Math.cos(elapsed * 0.5 + p.y * 0.035) * WIND_STRENGTH * 0.35;

        if (mouse.active) {
          var dx = p.x - mouse.x;
          var dy = p.y - mouse.y;
          var dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) || 0.0001;
          if (dist < HOVER_RADIUS) {
            var falloff = 1 - dist / HOVER_RADIUS;

            var rawDx = mouse.x - mouse.px;
            var rawDy = mouse.y - mouse.py;
            var rawDist = Math.sqrt(rawDx * rawDx + rawDy * rawDy);
            if (rawDist > MAX_HOVER_DELTA) {
              var s2 = MAX_HOVER_DELTA / rawDist;
              rawDx *= s2; rawDy *= s2;
            }
            p.px -= rawDx * HOVER_STRENGTH * falloff;
            p.py -= rawDy * HOVER_STRENGTH * falloff;

            var pull = falloff * falloff * SINK_STRENGTH;
            ax += (-dx / dist) * pull;
            ay += (-dy / dist) * pull;
          }
        }

        var vx = (p.x - p.px) * DAMPING + ax * dt * dt;
        var vy = (p.y - p.py) * DAMPING + ay * dt * dt;

        p.px = p.x;
        p.py = p.y;
        p.x += vx;
        p.y += vy;
      }

      p.elev = (p.x - p.restX) * LIGHT_X + (p.y - p.restY) * LIGHT_Y;
    }

    var passes = PHYSICS_PASSES;
    while (passes--) {
      for (var c = 0; c < constraints.length; c++) {
        var a = points[constraints[c][0]];
        var b = points[constraints[c][1]];
        var dx2 = b.x - a.x;
        var dy2 = b.y - a.y;
        var dist2 = Math.sqrt(dx2 * dx2 + dy2 * dy2) || 0.0001;
        var diff = (spacing - dist2) / dist2 * 0.5;
        var ox = dx2 * diff;
        var oy = dy2 * diff;
        if (!a.pinned) { a.x -= ox; a.y -= oy; }
        if (!b.pinned) { b.x += ox; b.y += oy; }
      }
    }
  }

  // Two fill() calls total per frame, no matter how fine the mesh is:
  //   1) the whole mesh silhouette, filled once with the real denim pattern
  //      (so edges still genuinely reveal the page background as they sway)
  //   2) the smooth light map from above, clipped to that same silhouette
  //      and blended with 'overlay' — this is what makes the fold actually
  //      look like it's carved into the cloth, with no cell edges anywhere.
  function draw() {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);

    if (mouse.active) {
      var stops = [[0, 0.30], [0.35, 0.20], [0.6, 0.10], [0.8, 0.04], [1, 0]];
      var sx = mouse.x + 6, sy = mouse.y + 10;
      var grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(sx, sy, 0, sx, sy, HOVER_RADIUS * 1.15);
      for (var gi = 0; gi < stops.length; gi++) {
        grad.addColorStop(stops[gi][0], 'rgba(4,8,16,' + stops[gi][1] + ')');
      }
      ctx.fillStyle = grad;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(sx, sy, HOVER_RADIUS * 1.15, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    var meshPath = new Path2D();

    for (var y = 0; y < ROWS; y++) {
      for (var x = 0; x < COLS; x++) {
        var i0 = x + y * (COLS + 1);
        var i1 = i0 + 1;
        var i2 = i0 + (COLS + 1);
        var i3 = i2 + 1;

        var p0 = points[i0], p1 = points[i1], p2 = points[i2], p3 = points[i3];

        var cx = (p0.x + p1.x + p2.x + p3.x) / 4;
        var cy = (p0.y + p1.y + p2.y + p3.y) / 4;
        var S = QUAD_OVERLAP;

        meshPath.moveTo(cx + (p0.x - cx) * S, cy + (p0.y - cy) * S);
        meshPath.lineTo(cx + (p1.x - cx) * S, cy + (p1.y - cy) * S);
        meshPath.lineTo(cx + (p3.x - cx) * S, cy + (p3.y - cy) * S);
        meshPath.lineTo(cx + (p2.x - cx) * S, cy + (p2.y - cy) * S);
        meshPath.closePath();
      }
    }

    ctx.fillStyle = denimPattern || BASE_FALLBACK_COLOR;
    ctx.fill(meshPath);

    // Write one grayscale pixel per mesh vertex (128 = flat, darker =
    // recessed, lighter = raised), then let drawImage's own bilinear
    // scaling turn that low-res buffer into a smooth, continuous gradient
    // across the whole cloth — the fold shape follows the real physics
    // exactly, but nothing snaps between discrete steps.
    if (lightMapData) {
      var d = lightMapData.data;
      for (var pi = 0; pi < points.length; pi++) {
        var g = 128 + Math.max(-120, Math.min(120, points[pi].elev * LIGHTMAP_SCALE));
        var o = pi * 4;
        d[o] = g; d[o + 1] = g; d[o + 2] = g; d[o + 3] = 255;
      }
      lightMapCtx.putImageData(lightMapData, 0, 0);

      ctx.save();
      ctx.clip(meshPath);
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'overlay';
      ctx.drawImage(lightMap, 0, 0, lightMap.width, lightMap.height, 0, 0, width, height);
      ctx.restore();
    }

    if (mouse.active) {
      var rim = ctx.createRadialGradient(mouse.x - 8, mouse.y - 12, 0, mouse.x - 8, mouse.y - 12, HOVER_RADIUS * 0.7);
      rim.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.10)');
      rim.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
      ctx.fillStyle = rim;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(mouse.x, mouse.y, HOVER_RADIUS, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  var lastTime = 0;
  function loop(t) {
    if (!running) return;
    if (!lastTime) lastTime = t;
    var dt = Math.min((t - lastTime) / 1000, 0.032);
    lastTime = t;

    step(dt);
    draw();
    rafId = requestAnimFrame(loop);
  }

  window.requestAnimFrame = window.requestAnimationFrame || function (cb) { return setTimeout(cb, 1000 / 60); };

  function start() {
    if (running) return;
    running = true;
    lastTime = 0;
    rafId = requestAnimFrame(loop);
  }

  function stop() {
    running = false;
    if (rafId) cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
  }

  var io = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
    entries.forEach(function (entry) {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) start(); else stop();
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.05 });
  io.observe(section);

  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function () {
    if (document.hidden) stop(); else if (isInViewport(section)) start();
  });

  function isInViewport(el) {
    var r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    return r.bottom > 0 && r.top < window.innerHeight;
  }

  canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', function (e) {
    var rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    var nx = e.clientX - rect.left;
    var ny = e.clientY - rect.top;

    if (!mouse.active) {
      mouse.px = nx;
      mouse.py = ny;
    } else {
      mouse.px = mouse.x;
      mouse.py = mouse.y;
    }
    mouse.x = nx;
    mouse.y = ny;
    mouse.active = true;
  }, { passive: true });

  canvas.addEventListener('pointerleave', function () {
    mouse.active = false;
  }, { passive: true });

  var resizeTimer;
  window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
    clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
    resizeTimer = setTimeout(buildCloth, 150);
  });

  buildCloth();
  start();
})();
</script>

</body>
</html>
